info.title: SendHog public API
info.description: SendHog public API and provider-shaped SDK subset. Own bearer authentication; not upstream wire/auth emulation. Sending remains operationally gated.

post.summary: Send one personalized email per recipient using a published template. Waits for SES acceptance, returns ordered individual outcomes. Idempotency-Key required; never automatically retries email.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Reuse a stable key for the same send. Never use a new key to blindly retry an unknown outcome.

get.summary: Inspect outcomes from a bulk send in the key domain without resending.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: Bulk operation ID returned by a previous bulk send.

get.summary: Read retained email events for an owned message, newest first. Events are retained for 30 days.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: SendHog message ID belonging to the API key’s domain.

schema.description: Maximum number of events to return in this page.
Cursor from the previous page's next_cursor. Omit for the first page.

get.summary: Download the retained original inbound email including attachments. Native HTTP streaming download, not a JSON SDK method.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: SendHog message ID belonging to the API key’s domain.

post.summary: Register a public HTTPS endpoint for signed email events. Returns the signing secret once.

delete.summary: Delete a domain-owned webhook and cancel pending deliveries.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: ID of the webhook registration to delete.

post.summary: Send inline subject/text/html or a published domain-scoped template ID/slug with variables. Verified domains receive automatic sending approval; account limits, disable controls and normal dispatch safeguards apply.

parameters.name: Idempotency-Key
parameters.description: Reuse a stable key for the same send. Never use a new key to blindly retry an unknown outcome.

get.summary: List retained email metadata and text in the key's domain, with a stable forward cursor.

schema.description: Maximum number of messages to return in this page.
Cursor from the previous page's next_cursor. Omit for the first page.

get.summary: Read one retained message in the key's domain. A foreign or missing ID returns 404.

parameters.name: id
parameters.description: SendHog message ID belonging to the API key’s domain.

to.description: Address that receives this individual message.

variables.description: Personal values for this recipient; override matching shared template values.

from.description: Sender address on the API key's verified domain.

subject.description: Optional subject override for the published template.

template.description: Published template and values shared by every recipient.

recipients.description: One entry per personalized message. Recipients do not see each other's addresses.

id.description: Message ID, when a message was accepted.

status.description: SES acceptance outcome, not inbox delivery. Do not blindly retry unknown outcomes. While processing, not_sent may mean not attempted yet.

id.description: Bulk operation ID. Use it to inspect results without sending again.

results.description: Individual outcomes in the same order as the submitted recipients.

id.description: Unique event ID. Use it to deduplicate inbound and delivery notifications alike.

type.description: The email activity reported by this event.

data.description: Message identifiers, domain-owned recipients and event-specific metadata. Received email bodies and attachments are fetched separately.

message_id.description: SendHog message ID; use messages.get for retained text or native GET /v1/messages/{id}/raw for a complete received email.

provider_id.description: Transport reference: SES message ID for outbound events; SendHog SMTP receipt ID for email.received.

recipients.description: Domain-owned envelope recipients associated with this event. A received event contains only its single receipt recipient.

details.description: Fields depend on type. email.received includes from, subject, header_message_id (nullable RFC Message-ID), raw_path and authentication signals; no body, attachments or storage credentials. Delivery events preserve provider-specific metadata.

limit.description: Maximum number of events to return in this page.

after.description: Cursor from the previous page's next_cursor. Omit for the first page.

next_cursor.description: Pass as after to read the next page; null at the end.

url.description: Public HTTPS endpoint that receives signed SendHog inbound and delivery-event notifications.

events.description: Event types for this same endpoint. Opt into email.received alongside bounces, deliveries and other events.

RawMessage.description: Retained original RFC822/MIME bytes including headers, bodies and attachments. Native HTTP streaming download; requires email.read. Not JSON or a presigned URL. Missing or foreign originals return404.

enabled.description: Whether notifications are enabled for this endpoint.

secret.description: Signing secret, returned only once. Store securely to verify incoming notifications; never log it.

data.description: Domain-owned webhook registrations, including disabled endpoints. Signing secrets are not included.

deleted.description: Confirms deletion and cancellation of pending notification deliveries.

ResolvedSendRequest.title: Inline email
ResolvedSendRequest.description: Provide at least one recipient in to, cc or bcc, and a plain-text or HTML body. Maximum 50 recipients total across all three fields.

from.description: Sender address on the API key's verified domain. Accepts an address or Name <address>.

to.description: Primary recipients. Provide one address or an array of addresses.

cc.description: Carbon-copy recipients, visible to other recipients.

bcc.description: Blind-copy recipients, hidden from other recipients.

replyTo.description: Addresses that should receive replies. One address or up to 10 addresses.

text.description: Plain-text message body. Required when html is not provided.

html.description: HTML message body. Required when text is not provided.

id.description: ID or slug of a published template in this domain.

version.description: Specific published version. Omit to use the current published version.

variables.description: Named values to substitute into the template.

TemplateSendRequest.title: Template email
TemplateSendRequest.description: Send using a published domain template instead of inline text or HTML. Provide at least one recipient in to, cc or bcc.

from.description: Sender address on the API key's verified domain.

subject.description: Optional subject override for the template.

template.description: Published template reference and substitution values.

id.description: SendHog message ID, returned after SES acceptance. Acceptance does not guarantee inbox delivery.

domain_id.description: Domain that owns this saved message.

direction.description: Whether this is a sent or received message. Receiving activation is separate.

to.description: Recipient addresses saved with this message.

status.description: Current summary status. Use the events endpoint for retained event history.

text.description: Retained plain-text body, or null when unavailable.

data.description: Messages in this page, scoped to the API key's domain.

next_cursor.description: Pass as after to read the next page; null at the end.

limit.description: Maximum number of messages to return in this page.

after.description: Cursor from the previous page's next_cursor. Omit for the first page.

error.description: Details about why the request failed.

request_id.description: Request identifier to include when contacting support.
